title: Scenario Diagnosis and Design Review: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Scenario Diagnosis and Design Review: Visual Guide

1. Symptom To Layer | the twelve-stage backbone from lesson 01 with six symptoms tapped against it, narrowing the suspect layers and naming the one cheap first check | symptoms surface at the top of the system but are caused at a layer, so triage is a lookup run in cost order, not an investigation

2. Chain Of Custody | the refund-policy incident walked in seven checks, clearing ingestion, parsing, chunking, filters and index rank until rerank position and the context budget are convicted | the evidence was reaching the reranker the whole time, so the fix is an afternoon of depth and context-k tuning and re-embedding would have cost a week for nothing

3. The Binding Stage | three real slowdowns with their per-stage measurements, and eight candidate fixes that either move the binding stage or return exactly zero | work on a stage that never moved buys no user-visible gain, so decompose and measure p95 per stage before proposing anything

4. Tokens In Tokens Out | sliders for context chunks and answer length driving input tokens, time to first token, decode time and perceived first-token latency, with reranker-threshold and streaming toggles | prefill tracks tokens in and decode tracks tokens out, and a latency fix that spends quality is a trade rather than a fix

5. Defending The Choice | five reviewer challenges answered twice, from preference and from constraints, with the six-item reviewer checklist responding to each | a defense is a constraint set, a rejection reason for each alternative and a stated reversal condition, and anything less is opinion
